claim_text: Feeding Our Future Form 990 Part VII for the fiscal period ending September 30, 2020 lists Aimee Bock as President (officer/key employee, 40 hours/week, reportable compensation $97,692) and board members Ben Stayberg, Ali Egal, Jamie Phelps, and John Senkler (5 hours/week, no reportable compensation listed). Part VII line 1b subtotal of reportable compensation is $100,000, which does not equal the $97,692 listed for Bock; that internal arithmetic discrepancy is preserved.
